custody.release_after: First published new model coordinate artifact from a succeeded provider Job in this Run. No coordinate, mapping, PDB accession, answer or reading is supplied to the research role before that condition.

quality.reference: experimentally observed model 1, chain A, 1F6S; UniProt mature chain verified identical upstream
quality.measures: C-alpha coverage out of all 123 pre-mapped positions; proper-rotation RMSD in angstroms. Alternate/nonunique coordinates invalidate their comparison. Predicted confidence reported separately.
quality.decision: At least 90% coverage and RMSD <=2.0 Å supports agreement of the mature-chain backbone in this deposit. >2.0 Å with coverage >=90% indicates lower agreement at this declared tolerance. <90% cannot classify whole-chain agreement. No activity, solution or binding claims.
quality.independent: Recompute from independent legacy PDB text and QCP fit; absolute agreement with plugin RMSD <=1e-5 Å. Exclude other chains, calcium/ligands and waters.
quality.confounding: No explicit input templates or MSA. Older public crystal may occur in training. Per-structure inclusion and this mounted parameter set exact cutoff unknown.
